content.summary: The most widely shared risk is reliance on joint ventures and strategic investments (LEA, ON, NXPI, GM), followed by IT/cyber disruption (BWA, GM). Other connected themes include technology change and EV adoption volatility (BWA, GM, TSLA), counterparty credit risk (ON), AI regulation and development (MCHP, TSLA), and spin-off risk (APTV).
